entry.title: New: Bill 137 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
RELATES TO PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS AND FINANCING THEREOF FOR THE FISCAL YEAR JULY 1, 2024, TO JUNE 30, 2025

Draft 2 requires a total appropriation of $495,835,000, of which $411,013,000 are intended to be funded in whole or part by bonds, $42,410,000 to be funded by Federal Grants, $41,462,000 to be funded by the State Revolving Loan Fund, and $950,000 to be funded by Community Benefit Assessments and other funds.

Latest action: Council: Bill 137, Draft 4, passes second & final reading - 05/30/24
